commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Chris Kavanagh has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Pascal Gross (Brighton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90+4' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+3' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
90+3' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Bart Verbruggen is well positioned and punches the ball away.

88' Bart Verbruggen pulls off a great save to deny Kai Havertz (Arsenal) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
84' The game is interrupted as Georginio Rutter (Brighton) is flagged offside.
83' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
82' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) gets a yellow card.
80' It's like he was asking for a caution. Olivier Boscagli (Brighton) receives a yellow card.
80' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Martin Zubimendi will be replaced by Christian Norgaard (Arsenal).
78' Today's match ends for Carlos Baleba who will be replaced by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
77' Substitution. Diego Gomez is replaced by Harry Howell (Brighton).
77' Here is a change. Mats Wieffer is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Joel Veltman (Brighton).
77' Diego Gomez (Brighton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
74' A precise short pass from Jurrien Timber releases Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post.
74' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
73' Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Diego Gomez (Brighton). Arsenal earn a free kick.
73' The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
72' The ball is cleared after Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for Arsenal.
69' Here comes a substitution. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Jack Hinshelwood.
69' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
69' This shall not pass! Carlos Baleba (Brighton) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
68' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Declan Rice (Arsenal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
67' Declan Rice (Arsenal) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
66' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
64' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is cleared away by the defence.
64' A substitution has been made. Cristhian Mosquera is replaced by Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal).
64' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
64' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but David Raya is prepared and dives to thwart him.
61' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

61' A pass into the penalty area from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is intercepted by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Substitution. Gabriel Martinelli will be replaced by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
59' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Viktor Gyökeres is replaced by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).

59' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from David Raya, who tips the ball around the post.
57' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
55' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
53' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
53' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
52' Diego Gomez (Brighton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
51' The resulting corner from Olivier Boscagli (Brighton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

50' Pascal Gross (Brighton) whips the ball into the box and Diego Gomez takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. Brighton force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Fabian Hurzeler gives a chance to Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) and Kaoru Mitoma is off.
46' Referee Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) trips an opposition player and Chris Kavanagh signals a foul.
45+3' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to find Jack Hinshelwood, but he puts too much power on the pass.
45+1' Diego Gomez (Brighton) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' The foul by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) was seen by Chris Kavanagh who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
41' Brighton are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
39' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
37' Diego Gomez (Brighton) serves up a nice cross, but David Raya punches the ball away.

35' What a chance that is! Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
33' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
31' Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal) brings his opponent down. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Declan Rice (Arsenal) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
28' Diego Gomez (Brighton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Chris Kavanagh saw the whole situation. A free kick is awarded to Arsenal.
28' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
27' Total attempts – 4:1.
25' Gabriel (Arsenal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
22' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and signals a foul after Diego Gomez (Brighton) brought his opponent down. Arsenal get a free kick.

22' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
21' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
18' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) was in a good position to shoot around the penalty spot after a nice pass, but his effort was unintentionally blocked by one of his teammates.
18' Wonderful movement by Brighton. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
17' Dangerous play by Jurrien Timber (Arsenal). Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
13' Diego Gomez (Brighton) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
13' Pascal Gross (Brighton) will take a corner kick.
12' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
11' Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
9' 0 - 1 Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) latches on to a brilliant pass and hits a poor shot towards the middle of the goal, but the ball goes into the back of the net after the goalkeeper makes a howler!
7' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
5' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
4' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
1' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
1' The first half has started.
